etymologies.etymologyHTML: Inherited from Middle English synger, syngere, singere, singare, equivalent to sing +‎ -er. Cognate with Scots singar, Saterland Frisian Sjunger, West Frisian sjonger, German Low German Singer. Compare also Old English sangere, Dutch zanger, German Low German Sänger, German Sänger (“singer”), Danish sanger, Swedish sångare, Icelandic söngvari.

definitions.definition: A person who sings, often professionally.
(square dance) dance figure with a fixed structure, sung by a caller, or a piece of music with that structure.

etymologies.etymologyHTML: From singe +‎ -er.

definitions.definition: A person who, or device which, singes.
